## Safety checklist

- [ ] Paper credits only. No real-money, wallet, exchange, payment or KYC code.
- [ ] State changes go through the command path (idempotency key, correlation ID, policy, audit).
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or credentials in the diff, fixtures, logs or screenshots.
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass locally.
- [ ] UI changes follow Stealth Signal (status = icon + text + color, one signal-green action).
